description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Trundle''' empowers his next [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attack]] within 7 seconds to have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], gain [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] 25 '''bonus''' range, deal '''bonus''' physical damage and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]] the target by 75% for 0.1 seconds.
description.text: Active: Trundle empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain  25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and slow the target by 75% for 0.1 seconds.

description2.raw: After using the empowered attack, '''Trundle''' gains [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] '''bonus''' attack damage for 5 seconds and reduces the target's '''bonus''' attack damage by half that amount for the same duration.
description2.text: After using the empowered attack, Trundle gains  bonus attack damage for 5 seconds and reduces the target's bonus attack damage by half that amount for the same duration.

description3.raw: ''Chomp [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Trundle's''' basic attack timer.''
description3.text: Chomp resets Trundle's basic attack timer.

notes.raw: * ''Chomp'' will still incur the [[File:Attack damage icon.svg|15px|link=Attack damage]] attack damage increase for '''Trundle''' even if the attack is [[File:Jax Counter Strike old.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Dodge]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|dodged]], [[File:Spirit's Refuge.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#Parrying|An icon representing the keyword Block]] [[:Attack_effects#Parrying|blocked]], missed while he is [[File:Blind icon.png|20px|link=Blind|An icon representing the keyword Blind]] [[:Blind|blinded]], or it is blocked by [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|spell shield]]. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the attack damage reduction and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slow]]. * If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's '''bonus''' attack damage below 0, the target's '''base''' attack damage value is unaffected, but their '''total''' attack damage will still be reduced. The target will however retain a '''bonus''' attack damage value of 0. ** Effects that scale with '''total''' attack damage, such as basic attacks, will take the attack damage reduction into account for their calculations. *** Those that have a ratio for '''base''' attack damage or '''bonus''' attack damage do not take the reduction into account.
notes.text:
Chomp will still incur the  attack damage increase for Trundle even if the attack is dodged, blocked, missed while he is blinded, or it is blocked by spell shield.
Spell shield will only block the attack damage reduction and slow.
If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's bonus attack damage below 0, the target's base attack damage value is unaffected, but their total attack damage will still be reduced. The target will however retain a bonus attack damage value of 0.
* Effects that scale with total attack damage, such as basic attacks, will take the attack damage reduction into account for their calculations.
** Those that have a ratio for base attack damage or bonus attack damage do not take the reduction into account.
